This feels good — checking "Read later" before saving set the link aside, and I could see it living in both places: still in my main library and also gathered in the separate Read later view in the sidebar. Keeping it in both spots is right; I wouldn't want setting something aside to make it vanish from my main collection.

Two things come to mind that are really the other half of this same idea, though:

First and most important — once I've actually read one of these, I need a way to mark it as done so it drops out of the Read later list. Otherwise that list just grows forever and stops meaning "still to read." The whole point of the list is that it empties as I get through things, so clicking something to say "I've read this" and having it leave the read-later view is essential for me.

Second, smaller: I don't always know at the moment I save something that it's for later. Often I save it normally and *then* decide I want to come back to it. So I'd want to be able to move an already-saved bookmark into Read later after the fact, not only decide it right at save time.

The setting-aside and the two-places part you've shown is exactly right — could we round it out with marking things as read to clear them, and being able to set something aside after it's already saved?
